tasks.original_prompt:
For this patient's hyperlipidemia: date of the most recent total cholesterol, days since then, and the home medications for that condition.
Context: patient MRN SYN-173ad094f7 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The condition is the Condition whose code.text contains 'hyperlipidemia' (case-insensitive) and none of: history of, gestational, pregnan, insipidus, prediabet, pre-diabet, pulmonary, portal, intracranial, ocular, neonatal. The monitoring test is total cholesterol (LOINC 35200-5). answer is {"condition": ..., "last_test_date": ..., "days_since": ..., "treatments": [...]}. condition (string) is that Condition's code.text; last_test_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is the effective date of the most recent Observation of that test with status final or corrected on or before the as-of date, and days_since (integer) the days from it to the as-of date, both null when there is none; treatments lists, sorted, the medicationCodeableConcept.text of every MedicationStatement with status active whose text contains any of: atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin, pravastatin, lovastatin, ezetimibe (case-insensitive). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Condition, the most recent test result and each listed MedicationStatement); when there is no result, the answer must also rest on a search of this patient's Observations filtered by patient and code (only _count may be added) that returns no records, using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
